questions.message: A full-time employee with less than 3 years’ service receives 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays. [1]
Report by 09:30 on the first day. Shift and on-call workers must report at least 1 hour before their shift or rota period starts. [1][2]
Submit within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred. For a multi-day trip, submit all expenses together within 30 calendar days of the trip’s first expense. [1][2]
The Head of Workplace Experience owns the Standard. [1]
The Leave and Absence Standard (NDS-HR-LAS-002 v1.2) is currently in force, effective 1 October 2026. It superseded Leave Policy NDS-HR-LV-006 v1.0. [1]
Probation is 6 months from the employee’s start date. It may be extended once, by up to 3 months, and the extension must be confirmed in writing before the original probation end date. [1]
The available policy documents don’t specify Northstar’s standard working or core hours. Please contact People Operations.
Salary is paid on the 25th of each month. If the 25th falls on a weekend or bank holiday, it’s paid on the previous working day. [1]
Report it to the IT Service Desk immediately, and no later than 1 hour after discovering it. [1][2]
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. MFA is mandatory for all Northstar systems. [1]
An employee can make up to 2 statutory flexible-working requests in any 12-month period. [1][2]
The annual learning budget is £1,000 per financial year (1 April to 31 March). [1]
The 2026 company shutdown is Tuesday 29 to Thursday 31 December 2026. [1]
What date in November will you start?
Call your line manager by 09:30 on your first day off sick. If you work shifts or are on call, call at least 1 hour before your shift or rota period starts. [1][2]

Yes. You can carry over up to 5 days of unused holiday without approval, and must use them by 31 March of the next leave year. [1]

Exceptions allow additional carryover for sickness absence, family-related leave, or approved exceptional business reasons; different limits and deadlines apply. [1]
No. For a three-day illness absence, complete a self-certification form in PeopleHub on the day you return; a fit note is required only for absences longer than 7 calendar days. [1]

Yes. If you work hybrid or remotely and have completed probation, you can claim up to £300 (including VAT) once in any 3-year period for a desk, chair or other ergonomic equipment, with receipts through ExpenseFlow. [1][2]
Yes, but only with Public information. Don’t enter Northstar Internal, Confidential or personal data into a free or consumer chatbot; Restricted information is prohibited in any AI tool. [1]

If the nursery closure is unexpected, you can take reasonable time off to arrange care for your child. [1] Northstar pays up to 2 working days for this occurrence, subject to a maximum of 5 paid days in the leave year; any further reasonable time is unpaid unless you choose annual leave. [1] Call your line manager as soon as reasonably practicable. [1]

You get 55p per business mile for your first 10,000 business miles in the tax year, then 25p per mile after that. If your trip starts or ends at home, deduct your normal commuting distance from each leg. [1]

No. Your holiday is not approved just because your manager hasn’t responded; it must show as “Approved” in PeopleHub before you take it. [1] Your manager must decide within 5 working days of submission; if there’s no decision by then, PeopleHub automatically escalates it to the Head of Department. [2]

Yes. You can take annual leave in whole-hour blocks, with a 1-hour minimum. Up to 37.5 hours per leave year may be taken this way, pro-rated for part-time employees; it counts against your allowance like full-day leave. [1]

You can report suspected misconduct to your line manager, People Operations, or through the whistleblowing procedure. [1] You can also contact the Head of Risk and Compliance at compliance@northstar.example, email speakup@northstar.example, or use the independent Speak Up line; it accepts anonymous reports. [2] If you ask for your identity to be protected, Northstar will protect it unless disclosure is required by law. [3]
No. During probation, you receive SSP only; no additional company sick pay is due. [1][2]

With 4 years’ service, your entitlement is up to 8 weeks at full pay, then 8 weeks at half pay in a rolling 12-month period; any company sick pay already paid in that period is deducted. [1] This scheme applies if your contract incorporates it; company sick pay includes SSP. [1]

If you expect to have responsibility for the child’s upbringing, you can take up to 2 weeks of paternity leave, even if you joined recently. [1] Because you joined only 2 months before the due date, you won’t meet the 26-week service requirement for Statutory Paternity Pay, so the leave will be unpaid; you may use annual leave instead. [1]
No. You can work from Spain only after completing probation, and you’ll still need prior approval through the Work From Abroad process. [1]

You must qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay and have at least 26 weeks’ continuous service at the end of the 15th week before your expected week of childbirth. [1]

- Weeks 1–16: full basic pay, inclusive of SMP.
- Weeks 17–39: SMP only.
- Weeks 40–52: unpaid. [1]

If you do not return to work for at least 6 months after maternity leave, you must repay the enhanced amount above SMP, unless an exception applies. [1]
Yes. First class is permitted for a 4-hour journey with Head of Department pre-approval before you incur the cost. [1][2]

If your 4 years of service are continuous, you would have at least 5 years’ continuous service by then and could apply for a 2-month sabbatical. [1][2] Apply at least 3 months before it starts; approval is discretionary and depends on business needs. [1]
The available bonus policy took effect on 1 October 2026, so it doesn’t cover a June/July 2026 bonus. Please contact People Operations.

Yes, potentially: a taxi journey at 22:30 qualifies for reimbursement up to £50 per journey, if it was necessary for Northstar business. [1][2] It must be reasonable, supported by evidence and approved; a fare over £50 needs Head of Department approval. [3][1][2]

Yes. For carryover from 2026 into 2027, more than 5 days may carry over if an exception applies [1][2]:
- Sickness prevented you taking leave: up to 20 days, pro-rated, in addition to the standard 5 [1][3].
- Family-related leave: all untaken leave for the year [1][3].
- Exceptional business reasons: up to 10 days total, with Director of People Operations approval; request by 30 November [1][3].

The standard 5 days must be used by 31 March 2027; exception deadlines depend on the reason [1][2].
You can claim it now only if you’ve completed probation. The allowance is up to £300, including VAT, once in any 3-year period, with receipts through ExpenseFlow. [1][2]
No. As a G4, you receive TOIL hour for hour, not paid overtime. [1]
No. You must decline it because the supplier is in an active contract negotiation with Northstar, regardless of the gift’s value. [1]

Possibly. You may work from Italy only if it is not on IT Security’s restricted-destination list and you have prior approval from your manager, People Operations and IT Security, with your request submitted at least 4 weeks ahead. [1][2]
You must not access Restricted payroll data from Italy unless the CISO approves it in writing and the customer contract permits it; otherwise, work only on tasks that do not involve that data, with UK-based cover arranged for Restricted tasks. [3][1][2]

Your final holiday balance is calculated up to your leaving date, so those five days booked after it aren’t deducted in that calculation. Any positive balance is paid in your final salary; a negative balance may be deducted where your contract permits. [1] The policy doesn’t say whether the bookings are automatically cancelled, so check with People Operations. [1]

Possibly, but you need both line-manager and Head of Department approval; leave during a published critical delivery period is normally approved only in exceptional circumstances. [1][2] For 3 working days, the minimum notice is 10 working days. [3]

Your 2027 allowance is split at 1 July, with each period prorated and the total rounded up to the next 0.25 hour. The bank holidays on your working days deduct 60 hours in total (37.5 before the change and 22.5 after it). [1]

Your remaining leave depends on your service:
- Under 3 years: 209.75 hours total; after bank holidays and the 60 hours already taken, 89.75 hours remain. [1]
- 3 to under 5 years: 215.75 hours total; 95.75 hours remain. [1][2]
- 5 or more years: 221.75 hours total; 101.75 hours remain. [1][2]

Each remaining amount includes 7.5 hours reserved for the Wednesday 29 December shutdown day. [1]

For international travel, get Director pre-approval and a Travel desk travel-risk check. [1] A taxi is reimbursable up to £50 per journey only in the listed circumstances, such as when no reasonable public transport is available, travelling between 22:00 and 06:00, carrying heavy or valuable equipment, or for safety or accessibility reasons; journeys above £50 need Head of Department approval. [2]

For the cash taxi fare, convert the euros using Finance’s published rate for that month: divide the euro amount by the rate in euros per £1, then claim the result in pounds. [3]

Call your line manager as soon as reasonably practicable because you’re in a different time zone; normally, sickness must be reported by 09:30 on the first day. Record it in PeopleHub that day, or ask your manager to do so. [1][2]

Provide self-certification for up to 7 calendar days, or a fit note for an absence of more than 7 calendar days. If you meet these requirements, your manager can reclassify the affected days as sickness and re-credit your leave. Reporting only after you return from holiday normally won’t qualify. [1][3]

Return your equipment by Friday 27 November 2026, within 5 working days after your leaving date. [1] Submit outstanding expenses by Friday 4 December 2026, within 10 working days after your leaving date. [2] Your system and building access will be revoked at 17:30 on Friday 20 November. [3] Your final holiday pay will be paid on Friday 25 December 2026. [4]

You may end the meeting or leave the site if you feel unsafe, and you won’t be penalised for doing so in good faith. [1] Follow the customer’s site incident procedure and report it to Northstar as well. [2] Report harassment by a customer to your line manager and People Operations within 1 hour. [3]

No. Don’t enter sickness records or diagnoses into Northstar Assist; health information must never be entered into a generative AI tool. [1] Ask People Operations about an approved way to review patterns; only People Operations case owners can access medical details in PeopleHub. [1]

Northstar must allow you time off for jury service. If your absence would seriously harm the business, Northstar may ask you to apply to defer, with a letter explaining why; jury service can be deferred only once in a 12-month period. [1]

Northstar pays full basic pay for the first 10 working days in any leave year. After that, Northstar does not pay, but you may claim loss of earnings from the court; People Operations will complete the court’s employer form. [1]

For your first 4 weeks, you must attend at least 3 days per week. The available sources don’t say how much leave you can book by June or when you can claim a home office allowance. Please contact People Operations for those details.
No. Pregnancy-related sickness is excluded from attendance triggers. [1]
You can book 112.5 hours of annual leave in 2027. [1]
They get 23.0 days of annual leave for 2027 [1], plus 7 bank holidays as paid days off [2].
Holiday pay due is **£612.50 gross**: the pro-rated entitlement is 13.5 days, leaving 3.5 days after 10 days taken. [1]
For 2027, bookable annual leave depends on service length: less than 3 years: 191.75 hours; 3 to under 5 years: 198.5 hours; 5 or more years: 205.25 hours. [1][2][3]
They receive **£98.60 in SSP** for the 4 working days; no company sick pay is due during probation. [1][2]
They receive 13 weeks at full pay, followed by 2 weeks at half pay. Weeks 14 and 15 are paid at £500 per week, £1,000 total; company sick pay includes SSP. [1][2]

£342 is reimbursed: rail £84, hotel £180, meals £73 after deducting the wine, and £5 incidental allowance. The £15 hotel excess is not reimbursed unless the Head of Department approves an exception. [1] The £342 claim requires line manager and Head of Department approval. [1]
You can claim **£45.00**: 50 miles at 55p and 70 miles at 25p. [1][2]
No. You gave 9 working days’ notice, but 10 are required for 3 days off. [1][2] Your request is short notice and may be approved at your manager’s discretion. [1][2]

Full-time: you need **6 office days** in the 4-week period after taking 5 days of annual leave. [1]

If you work 3 days a week and also take 5 scheduled workdays off, you need **3 office days** in the period. [1]
Northstar must give 9 weeks’ notice: the statutory minimum is longer than the 1-month contractual notice for a G2 employee. [1]
The statutory redundancy pay is £4,506: 6 years × 1 week per year × the £751 weekly cap. [1]
They get 8.0 days of annual leave for 2027, plus the 27 and 28 December bank holidays. Three of the annual leave days must be reserved for the shutdown from 29 to 31 December. [1]
A £1,200 claim needs approval from your line manager, Head of Department and Director. [1]
The hotel limit in Zurich is £300 per night. [1]
Right-to-work check copies are kept for the duration of employment plus 2 years. [1]
The highest data classification allowed in Northstar Knowledge Search is Internal. [1]
After probation, a G5 employee must give 2 months’ notice when resigning. Your individual employment contract prevails if it sets a different notice period. [1]
At the end of month 3, your manager holds a mid-point review. Any concerns should be identified in writing, with support offered; People Operations is involved if concerns exist. [1][2]
This is Severity 3 — Medium. [1] Report it within 1 hour of discovery to the IT Service Desk or security@northstar.example. [2][3]
The dinner limit for Paris is £45 per day. [1]
You may accept it, but you must record it in the gifts and hospitality register within 5 working days. [1]
Recruitment records for unsuccessful candidates are kept for 6 months after the hiring decision. [1]
Under the standard rule, you can carry over up to 22.5 hours (37.5 hours × 0.6 FTE). You must use it by 31 March of the next leave year. [1][2][3]
Submit all outstanding expense claims within 10 working days after your leaving date. [1]
Is the log Restricted or Confidential, and which AI tool would you use?
If Northstar requested the trip for customer work, it does not count towards your 10 Work From Abroad days. [1]
Yes. If you drive your own car, you can claim an extra 5p per mile for each colleague travelling with you on the same business journey, on top of the applicable mileage rate. [1]
No. Northstar pays Shared Parental Pay only; there is no company enhancement. [1]
No. Home broadband is not reimbursable as part of hybrid working. [1][2]
Prompts and outputs in approved tools, including Northstar Assist, are kept for 90 days. [1]

The deadlines are:
- Acknowledgement: within 5 working days of receipt. [1]
- Meeting to discuss the request: within 4 weeks of receipt. [1]
- Appeal: within 10 working days of the decision. [1]
- The written decision and any appeal must be completed within 2 months of the request, unless you agree to an extension. [1]
Follow the current Leave and Absence Standard. It has applied since 1 October 2026 and superseded the archived Leave Policy, which should not be used for current decisions. [1]

Hybrid employees are provided a laptop, one external monitor, a keyboard, a mouse and a headset. [1] These remain Northstar property and must be returned within 5 working days after your leaving date using IT’s prepaid courier; you may include your access card. [2][3]
Do you mean annual leave, and if so, how many working days and what dates in November?
Do you mean time off sick, annual leave, or another kind of absence?

You can request a permanent remote contract through a statutory flexible-working application or role change. It requires approval from your Head of Department and People Operations, and your contractual workplace must be in the UK. [1][2]
What was the expense for, when did you incur it, and how much was it?
If you’re an employee with parental responsibility for the child, you’re eligible for unpaid parental leave from your first day of employment. [1]
Are you still in probation? If not, what is your grade (G1–G7)?
Do you mean carry the laptop while travelling, or use it to work from abroad?
I can’t access your personal leave balance. Please contact People Operations to confirm how many days you have left.
No fixed increase is stated. Salary increases are discretionary and not guaranteed; any change is normally effective 1 April. [1]
The available sources don’t provide the Leeds office Wi-Fi password. Please contact People Operations.
I can’t see your leave request or its approval status. Check PeopleHub; leave is approved only when it shows “Approved.” If you need help, contact People Operations.
The available sources don’t cover maternity policy for employees employed in the Republic of Ireland. Please contact People Operations.
The available sources don’t provide employee sick-leave counts. Please contact People Operations.
The available sources don’t state the 2026/27 bonus pool amount. Please contact People Operations.
No. Company cars are not listed as a benefit, and benefits not listed in the handbook or a supporting standard are not offered. [1]
I can’t disclose a colleague’s sickness or diagnosis. You can ask about general sickness absence policy or how to support a colleague.
I can’t disclose another employee’s salary. You can ask about your own pay or general payroll policy instead.
I can’t disclose employees’ performance or PIP status. I can explain the general PIP process instead.
No. Sickness records contain health information and must never be entered into any generative AI tool, including a free online tool. [1][2]
The available sources don’t list salary bands. Please contact People Operations.

The four headline numbers are 27 days’ annual leave (plus 8 bank holidays), 5 days’ carryover, a 09:30 sickness-reporting deadline, and 8 office or customer-site days in each rolling 4-week period for hybrid roles. [1]
Yes. The Standard says they may book up to 9.0 days by 1 June, with line manager approval. Any leave over 5 consecutive working days also needs Head of Department approval. [1]
MeetingScribe allows information classified up to Confidential. It can’t be used in HR, medical, whistleblowing, or unconsented customer meetings. [1]
Follow the policy document; it prevails over a training slide if they differ. [1][2]
No. You can claim up to £300 for eligible home-office equipment only after completing probation, with receipts. [1][2] You’re not eligible to work from Spain while still in probation. [3]
With 3 years’ service, the entitlement is 8 weeks at full pay, followed by 8 weeks at half pay, in any rolling 12-month period. This includes SSP. [1]
